content:
Apple Music Hall has added Kings of Leon to its lineup of upcoming gigs at the newly opened London venue. Here are the details.

More live performances coming to Apple Music Hall

In September, Sir Elton John gave the first-ever performance at Apple Music Hall, a new live music venue in Battersea, London.

The show was broadcast live on Apple Music and is now available on the platform to subscribers.

Since then, Baby Keem, Skye Newman, Troye Sivan, Arlo Parks, and Burna Boy have performed at the venue, with Chase & Status and Charli xcx scheduled to take the stage in the coming weeks.

In an email to Apple Music subscribers, the company confirmed Kings of Leon will perform at Apple Music Hall on December 7, with tickets going on sale November 18 at 10 a.m. GMT for £40.

A few days later, on December 10, R&B and soul singer-songwriter Jorja Smith will also perform at Apple Music Hall. As with the Kings of Leon concert, tickets will go on sale November 18 at 10 a.m. GMT, priced at £40.

As a reminder, Apple Music Hall performances are also streamed on Apple Music, with recordings of previous shows available to subscribers.

To learn more about Apple Music Hall, including upcoming performances and ticket information, follow this link.

Apple Music requires an active subscription. You can sign up for $11.99 per month, with 1 month free, or as part of the Apple One bundle.
